correctness.rationale: The published iteration reduces exactly to an affine matrix recurrence on the stated deterministic quadratic. Summing the recurrence proves the transfer polynomial. value.rationale: The source itself reports sensitivity to the negative-momentum coefficient and identifies adaptive tuning as future work. The exact filter exposes a sharp structural capability and limitation of that coefficient on the canonical local quadratic model: one movable notch, exact one-epoch solution precisely when \(m\eta\lambda>1\) on the isotropic case, and inability to cancel two distinct admissible curvatures at once. This is a motivated parameter-calibration fact rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
